The reviewer almost certainly followed our instructions correctly and still got a sour batch because the instructions themselves do not suit this specific blend.

Husband tried it in milk per the package suggestion and mixed into eggs, disliking both. Customer notes the powder is not flavorless, indicating they expected the Unflavored label to mean tasteless. Product B0GWJSMDHW is a single-ingredient, cold-pressed pumpkin seed protein that naturally carries a strong earthy, nutty flavor and smell. This is a genuine product-experience complaint, not a guideline violation.

nrSummary.notes: 2-star review titled "A California Trophy Wife's Brutal Review." Core complaint is genuine: the pumpkin seed protein powder (PP-PUMPKIN-16OZ) was gritty and chalky and did not blend smoothly in almond milk, coconut milk, or juice. She also objects to dairy-free/gluten-free/Made in USA being marketed as selling points. A large portion of the review is unrelated personal narrative (parenting, cosmetic procedures, etc.). She explicitly states other Seedboy products are good. No return or refund mentioned.
